summary: 10.0.41.05 Mojibake Eradication, Single-Timer Clock Synchronization & Non-Destructive DOM Stability
highlights: 1. Complete Mojibake Eradication: Replaced corrupted encoding with safe numeric HTML entities across all 42 views and index.html.
2. Single-Timer Clock Synchronization: Removed competing interval in index.html; unified FormatUtil to provide steady, non-blinking footer timestamps.
3. Non-Destructive KPI Enhancement: Prevented KpiCardEnhancer from destroying card innerHTML and wiping out accounting subtitles.
4. Clean Table Header Parity: Prevented TableUiEnhancer from mutating table headers into colorful pill buttons.
5. Universal Frame-0 Refresh Parity: Ensures 100% identical layout and data presentation before and after refresh.
